Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nitin - 30 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Sanjay - 28 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator
2. The gym - dumbbells, a treadmill, mirrors
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Nitin stands in the mall. Sanjay stands near him.]

Nitin: "What lovely weather!"

[Nitin tries on a new jacket.]

Nitin: "How beautiful!"

[Nitin pays at the counter.]

Sanjay (excited): "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The gym - Day

[Nitin stands in the gym. Sanjay stands near him.]

Nitin: "Sanjay, look over here."

[Nitin lifts weights and grunts.]

Sanjay (excited): "Look at this."

[Nitin does push-ups on the mat.]

Sanjay: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin wipes the sweat off his forehead.]

Nitin (excited): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

Sanjay: "Let's begin."

[Nitin cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Nitin: "That's great!"

[The knife slips and Nitin's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Nitin: "What happened?"

[Nitin winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Nitin: "That was such a fun day!"
